**0906 Ekko-kardiografi** is a medical procedure code registered in the [[sygesikringsregisteret|Sygesikringsregisteret]] (National Health Service Register) in Denmark [^src1]. It is specifically used to identify [[ekkokardiografi|echocardiography]] examinations in the context of clinical quality measurement and monitoring for patients diagnosed with atrial fibrillation [^src1]. 

As part of the national quality indicators managed by the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP) and the Danish Healthcare Quality Programme, this code helps define the technical parameters for tracking whether atrial fibrillation patients receive timely and appropriate diagnostic imaging [^src2]. The calculation rules and technical guidelines for the Atrial Fibrillation in Denmark (AFDK) database rely on such precise coding to standardize data collection, define denominators and numerators, and enable cross-regional comparison across the Danish healthcare system [^src3]. 

The Sygesikringsregisteret utilizes a comprehensive set of codes to capture different types and complexities of echocardiographic procedures. Alongside 0906, the register includes [[2208-ekkocardiografi|2208 Ekkocardiografi]], [[3810-ekkocardiografi-standardundersoegelse|3810 Ekkocardiografi, standardundersøgelse]], [[3811-ekkocardiografi-avanceret-undersoegelse|3811 Ekkocardiografi, avanceret undersøgelse]], [[5101-ekko-cardiografi|5101 EKKO-cardiografi]], [[5102-transsofageal-ekko|5102 Transsøfofagal ekko.]], [[5103-stress-ekkocardiogra|5103 Stress ekkocardiogra]], [[6402-ekkocardiografi|6402 Ekkocardiografi]], and [[6408-ekkocardiografi|6408 Ekkocardiografi]] [^src1]. Together, these codes form the foundational data infrastructure for evaluating cardiovascular care quality and ensuring evidence-based clinical standards are met in Denmark [^src3].
